description: Found 2026-11-11 on develop c7b75c80bc (macOS arm64, DuckDB 1.5.5). `benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 1 --official --seed 42 --phases generate,load,power --compression zstd:9 --non-interactive` runs the workload, then export raises `ResultExportError: Failed to export json: PASSED row_count_validation requires equal integer expected and actual counts` (benchbox/core/results/query_execution.py:380) and no bundle is written. It fails the same way with and without `--capture-plans`, so plan capture is not the cause. Some measured row carries row_count_validation status PASSED with expected != actual, which the export contract rejects. This is the exact command of the seed-corpus matrix cell for TPC-H SF 1 (`official: true`); the last scheduled seed-corpus run succeeded on 2026-11-01, so either the regression is newer or it is host-specific. The same run at SF 0.1 without a seed exports cleanly. Not yet known: which query, and whether Linux CI reproduces.
